description: Maandelijkse stiptheid per stopplaats is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Maandelijks percentage van alle binnenlandse reizigerstreinen die met een vertraging van maximaal 5 minuten en 59 seconden aangekomen zijn in het stopplaats. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Traffic beheer, Geolocatie. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers, Stations, Binnenlandse treinen. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
